title: SQL Injection vulnerability in search filter
body: Raw user input is concatenated directly into SQL queries in tasks/service.py, leading to remote code execution and data leak.

title: Application crash on server startup when DB file is missing
body: Server throws uncaught FileNotFoundError and crashes immediately upon startup if taskboard.db does not exist.

title: Plaintext passwords saved in database
body: Password hashing is bypassed when registering users through the API endpoint, saving plaintext passwords in SQLite.

title: Cannot create new tasks: 500 internal server error
body: Submitting the task creation form always fails with 500 error due to missing assignee_id column in database schema.

title: User login session token expires immediately
body: Session tokens expire within 1 second of generation, logging out all users on the next request.

title: Task status cannot be updated from in_progress to completed
body: Calling PUT /tasks/1/status with completed returns 400 Bad Request because of a typo in the status validation list.

title: Password reset email is never sent
body: Clicking forgot password results in a success message on the frontend but no email is ever dispatched.

title: Task card title overflows column boundary on mobile screens
body: Long task titles do not wrap or truncate, causing the kanban column to stretch horizontally on viewport width < 600px.

title: Date format inconsistency in task created_at timestamps
body: Some task timestamps use ISO-8601 with UTC offset while others use local time strings without timezone indicators.

title: Search query does not ignore case
body: Searching for 'bug' does not return tasks titled 'Bug in parser'. Search filter should be case-insensitive.

title: CLI list-tasks command prints unaligned columns
body: When task titles are varying lengths, the terminal table output has misaligned borders.

title: Minor CSS margin glitch in navbar icon

title: Typo in error response message for invalid email
body: The validation error message says 'Invalide email adress' instead of 'Invalid email address'.

title: Button hover state color slightly washed out in dark mode

title: Console warning about deprecated fetch parameter
